referenceSources.title: Revive tu mejor infancia con este icono del Gran Turismo, porque el indomable TVR Speed 12 ahora puede ser tuyo
referenceSources.description:
A striking red TVR Cerbera Speed 12, chassis W112 BHG, dominates the frame with its muscular front end, quad circular headlights, and large central grille emblazoned with the TVR badge. The car’s wide fenders, low ground clearance, and carbon‑fiber splitter underscore its racing DNA, while the prominent rear wing hints at its Le Mans GT1 origins.

Born from a 1990 project to rival the McLaren F1 GTR, the Speed 12’s 7.7‑liter V12—rumored to exceed 1,000 CV—was officially rated at 960 CV before being detuned to 880 CV for the lone 2005 street‑legal example. Now up for auction, this unique TVR Cerbera Speed 12 remains in excellent condition, complete with its original ECU and exhausts, ready to pass UK road certification.
